units.source_text: 这个时候，金花注意到，有人悄悄地来到她身后。

en.t: At that moment, Jinhua noticed that someone had quietly come up behind her.

units.source_text: 她拿着筷子，轻轻看向后面，

en.t: Still holding her chopsticks, she quietly looked behind her,

units.source_text: 让她惊讶的是，她身后没有窗户，

en.t: To her surprise, there was no window behind her,

units.source_text: 只见一个陌生的外国人叼着黄铜烟斗，正悠闲的坐在铺着缎子坐垫的紫檀椅子上。

en.t: she saw a strange foreigner with a brass pipe in his mouth, sitting at ease in a red sandalwood chair covered with a satin cushion.
